title: Phantoms and Diamonds (Vocadito 18)
reference_type: Analyst-proposed bar navigation, pending independent human aural and metrical review
reference_basis: Manual phrase reading gives corresponding starts at 0.46, 9.06, 17.62 and 26.27 s from both note annotations. The 8.60 s phrase period supports a candidate division into four 2.15 s bars. The source WAV confirms the pauses after the first three phrases. The 4/4 subdivision and bar phase are hypotheses. No vocal syllable was treated as an observed downbeat.
